projectState.summary: Byte 13b-b is approved, merged into `main`, and the Claude review artifact has been cherry-picked. It adds a browser-side persistence queue in `src/persistence.ts`, Vite dev middleware endpoints under `/api/persistence/status`, `/api/persistence/append`, and `/api/persistence/dump`, batch `appendEvents`, and app wiring for `session.started`, `session.mode_changed`, `song.changed`, and `timing.feel_changed`. The queue schedules flushes outside UI handlers and no persistence call is made from Tone scheduler callbacks or `handleMusicalEvent`. The persistence schema now uses `beat` and `scheduled_beat` columns. Byte 13b-c1 is the next clean slice: harden the persistence writer with read-only/no-db dump behavior, unavailable/offline coverage, bounded retry/backoff, pagehide best-effort flush, and a visible/debug persistence status line before `musical.event_recorded`.
